budget.semantics: Actual construction failures remain counted. Numeric camera exit is zero only with pinned producer phase plus exact completed typed error and zero render-attempt events.

limits_and_unverified: Single correctness sample per input/variant. No paired performance admission or model-benefit estimate.
NPZ producer byte hashes and saved PNG delivery checked. This runtime audit does not rerasterize depth/owner truth.

Worker event status fields, including the close event default unknown, are not process cleanup evidence.
Main capture and later task/aabb readback remain separate; the latter never fills missing geometry in a failed main request.
Output audit fields measure LF text before platform translation. Actual wire size/hash comes from original stdio RX.bin.
Temporary bytecode is excluded from harness source dependencies. Historical cleanup refusal is retained without deletion attempts.
